lines: Want to draw on Tilo, and show your work in the gallery? Here's how to get in. It takes a minute.
Go to tiloart dot com slash join, and leave your email. Tilo is in a closed beta, so we let people in a few at a time.
When there's a place, your invite arrives by email. Press, Join Tilo.
Sign in with that same address. There's no password. Tilo emails you a link, and one tap signs you in.
Now pick your handle. Your invite code is already filled in. Tick the box, and you're a member.
Open the studio, choose a pencil, ink, or pixels, and draw. Every stroke is recorded as you go.
Publish it, and it hangs in the gallery with its recording, so anyone can replay how you drew it.
Then stamp the pieces you love, follow artists, and add your marks to the shared wall.
Can't wait for your code? Start drawing now. No account needed. Your sheets stay on your device until you're in. Tiloart dot com slash join.
